title: What needs what, in the City's own words
question: Which permits and approvals do the City's published pages say must be in hand before, or together with, another permit?
finding: Of 1,449 sentences pulled from City permit pages, 98 state a real dependency, giving 108 distinct pairs: 60 say one thing must come before the other, and 48 say both are needed without giving an order. The building permit has the most: 21 stated prerequisites, 16 of them required before it is applied for or issued.
how: Every sentence in the extracted table was read. A sentence was kept only if it names what is needed and what it is needed for (or the page is about one permit) and says it is required. The pair was read from the sentence by hand and is listed in the script; the script confirms each sentence is in the table and takes the quotation and link from the table row. "Before" means the sentence states an order; "as well" means it only says both are required.
limits: These are sentences on web pages, not the legal code, which could not be downloaded. Requirements printed only inside PDF forms, bulletins or the codes are missing, so the true list is longer. Most prerequisites apply only in the circumstance shown ("when it applies"); no single job needs all of them. Quotations are cut to 25 words.
